## Data
The **mlb_pitching_2024.csv** dataset contains 77 rows and 16 column. Each row represents a game that Shai Gilgeous-Alexander played during the 2024-25 regular season. **Note:** The dataset includes the NBA Cup Championship game, which is not officially counted in regular season statistics by the NBA.

Download Data:[sga_stats_2025.csv](/data_repo_submission/sga_stats_2025.csv){target="_blank"}

<details>

<summary><b>Variable Descriptions</b></summary>

| Variable          | Description
|-------------------|------------------------------------------------
| minutes    | Total minutes played in the game

</details>
